terms.definition: A group of the same species living in the same area at the same time.
terms.function: The level of ecology for counting one species.
terms.whyItMatters: Populations are how we track species health.

terms.definition: The increase in population size when gains outnumber losses.
terms.whyItMatters: Growth or decline tells us how a species is doing.

terms.definition: A resource or threat that caps population size.
terms.function: Stops a population from growing without end.
terms.whyItMatters: They keep populations in balance with their environment.
